verdict.rationale: Poke's docs show first-party email (read, search, draft) and calendar (scheduling, availability) capabilities. They also describe integrations that let Poke access information across connected apps through conversation. However, no cloud-drive connector is evidenced; custom MCP servers are only a building block for one. Missing for 10: a documented cloud drive connector (e.g., Google Drive/Dropbox) with search, explicit evidence that connected content is retrieved and grounded into answers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can connect my cloud drive, email, and calendar so the assistant can search and use them in answers

citations.quote: Email Management - Read, search, and draft emails without leaving your messages
Calendar - Schedule meetings and check your availability
Once connected, Poke can access information and perform actions across apps and services through natural conversation.
